item.author: Rolling Stone (@rollingstone.com)
item.description:
Malcolm Todd talks to Don Toliver about being able to make a lit song just from a bridge.

Malcolm: “Honestly, some songs I think aren't that good, but the bridge is insane, and I build like a whole song around the fact that I love the bridge.”

Don: “Bro, that's like the magic of songwriting.”
